recheck.issue: ask_assistant/audit: 'one [unit] per fold' plus 'check on later periods' cannot both hold for one partition of panel rows, and 'zero units on both sides' is wrong when the model scores known units in later periods
recheck.reason: Right for the brief and audit text: holding out whole units AND checking forward means training each check only on earlier periods (dropping the rest), and a model that scores existing units next month is validated walk-forward with those units on both sides. panel_leak.the_fix says 'split by advertiser (and by time)'. The spoken seg 7 and its card are framed on meeting new advertisers (panel_leak.truth_on_new_advertisers), where 'whole advertisers held out, each check on later months' is achievable and true, so narration is left as is; quiz 4-2-q4 is that same new-advertiser case and stays.
recheck.change: ask_assistant now splits case two: new [units] -> hold out whole [units], train each check only on earlier [periods], print units on both sides: zero; same [units] later -> walk forward instead; leave a gap as long as the [outcome window]. 120 words. audit_checklist[0]: the zero-overlap and later-months demand applies to a model that must meet new advertisers.

recheck.issue: other_ways: 'train on January and February and choose on March' ignores the 60-day label gap
recheck.reason: data.why_a_gap: with a 60-day outcome the month before the scored month's answers are not known at scoring time; the course's own split leaves April as the gap.
recheck.change: other_ways[0].when: train on the earliest months and choose on a later one with a gap as long as the outcome window (for a 60-day outcome: train on January, skip February, choose on March), or walk forward.
